# LevelMeter

> Live audio level in dBFS with warning and clip zones and a peak hold, painted without React renders.

This file matches the installed `level-meter` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/level-meter.json
```

With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/level-meter.md`.

## Usage

```tsx
"use client";

import { useId } from "react";
import {
  LevelMeter,
  LevelMeterBar,
  LevelMeterPeak,
  LevelMeterScale,
  type LevelMeterSource,
  LevelMeterTrack,
} from "@/components/control-ui/ui/level-meter";
import { Text } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/typography";

const speechLikeVoice: LevelMeterSource = {
  subscribe(listener) {
    let frame = 0;
    const emitLevel = (nowMs: number) => {
      const syllable = Math.abs(Math.sin(nowMs / 170)) * Math.abs(Math.sin(nowMs / 1300));
      listener(-50 + syllable * 46 + Math.random() * 4);
      frame = requestAnimationFrame(emitLevel);
    };
    frame = requestAnimationFrame(emitLevel);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
  },
};

export function PrimitiveLevelMeterExample() {
  const labelId = useId();
  return (
    <div className="flex w-full max-w-sm items-end gap-8 px-3">
      <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col gap-2">
        <Text id={labelId} size="label" weight="medium">
          Microphone
        </Text>
        <LevelMeter aria-labelledby={labelId} source={speechLikeVoice}>
          <LevelMeterTrack>
            <LevelMeterBar />
            <LevelMeterPeak />
          </LevelMeterTrack>
          <LevelMeterScale ticks={[0, -6, -12, -18, -24, -36, -48, -60]} />
        </LevelMeter>
      </div>
      <LevelMeter aria-label="Program level" orientation="vertical" source={speechLikeVoice} className="h-40">
        <LevelMeterTrack>
          <LevelMeterBar />
          <LevelMeterPeak />
        </LevelMeterTrack>
        <LevelMeterScale />
      </LevelMeter>
    </div>
  );
}
```
